pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.62-$0.83 per click (median $0.72), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.

allocations.rationale: market price $0.58-$0.79 (median $0.67); bidding $0.47 wins ~6% of page views, paying ~$0.44 per click (second price); host also sells this kind of product: confirm it allows competing brands

not funded at this budget: cheaper conversions are available on the other hosts first (market price here $0.62-$0.83); it gets budget as the budget grows or if a funded host declines; host also sells this kind of product: confirm it allows competing brands
not funded at this budget: cheaper conversions are available on the other hosts first (market price here $0.86-$1.16); it gets budget as the budget grows or if a funded host declines
